_comment: LLM models for mage-bench. Prices are $/million tokens via OpenRouter (Feb 2026). Reasoning tokens billed as output tokens.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models._notes: Best bang for buck. Produces reasoning text with tool calls ~57% of the time. Already tested — works well, good at trash talk. Thinking mode available via effort param.

models.name: Gemini 3 Flash
models._notes: Slightly pricier than 2.5 Flash but newer. Already tested — rarely produces reasoning text (4/346 responses). May improve with thinking mode enabled.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models._notes: Strong reasoning model. Should outperform Flash variants on complex board states and combat math. Worth testing with thinking mode on.

models.name: Gemini 3 Pro
models._notes: Latest Gemini Pro. Should have best Gemini-family strategic reasoning. Thinking mode available.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models._notes: Cheapest Claude with extended thinking (min 1024 tokens, max 128K). Good tool use. Likely solid at Magic — Claude models understand complex rules well. Extended thinking should help with combat math.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
models._notes: Strong all-rounder with extended thinking. Excellent tool use and instruction following. Probably the best mid-tier option for strategic play. 1M context available.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models._notes: Most capable Claude. Extended thinking up to 128K tokens. Likely best strategic play but very expensive — a full Commander game could cost $5-10+. Use for showcase matches, not bulk testing.

models.name: o4-mini
models._notes: OpenAI's latest small reasoning model. Internal chain-of-thought (not visible in output). Poor tool-use reliability in practice — cascading empty responses and very few meaningful game actions in testing. Removed from default rotation.

models.name: o3
models._notes: Strong reasoning model but unreliable tool use — persistent empty responses and stall loops in testing (24 counted empties across 3 stall cycles in game_20260210_230611). Removed from default rotation. Internal chain-of-thought with effort levels (low/medium/high). Thinking is opaque — reasoning_content not exposed.

models.name: o3-mini
models._notes: Cheaper reasoning model. Similar to o4-mini but older. Internal reasoning only.

models.name: GPT-5.2
models._notes: GPT-5.2 WITHOUT reasoning_effort param. Played terribly (63 major blunders in game_20260228_172012_g2). Supports optional adaptive reasoning via reasoning.effort — use gpt52-medium preset instead. Internal reasoning not exposed in response.

models.name: GPT-5.3 Codex
models._notes: OpenAI's most advanced agentic coding model. Mandatory reasoning (low/medium/high/xhigh, default medium). Combines GPT-5.2-Codex SWE performance with GPT-5.2 broader reasoning. Internal reasoning only — not exposed in response.

models.name: GPT-5
models._notes: OpenAI's flagship model. Mandatory reasoning. Strong at complex tasks, reduced hallucination. Cheaper than GPT-5.2 ($1.25/$10 vs $1.75/$14). Internal reasoning only — not exposed in response.

models.name: GPT-5.1
models._notes: Previous gen GPT. No reasoning mode. Large context but expensive output. Probably not worth it over o3/o4-mini for Magic.

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models._notes: Very cheap reasoning model. Extended thinking with up to 32K reasoning tokens. Unclear how well it handles tool calling — DeepSeek models can be inconsistent with complex tool schemas. Worth testing.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill 32B
models._notes: Distilled 32B variant of R1. Extremely cheap with reasoning support. Small context window (32K). Good for comparison against full R1 to measure distillation quality loss.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models._notes: Absurdly cheap. No reasoning mode. Good for bulk/baseline testing to see if a non-thinking model can play Magic at all. May struggle with complex tool schemas.

models.name: Mistral Large
models._notes: No reasoning mode. Devstral (similar family) was tested and produced 0/255 reasoning text. Probably a weak Magic player without thinking. Skip unless specifically benchmarking non-thinking models.

models.name: Grok 4
models._notes: xAI flagship reasoning model. Mandatory internal reasoning (not exposed). Supports parallel tool calling. Good for showcase/frontier matches.

models.name: Grok 4 Fast
models._notes: Absurdly cheap with optional reasoning. 2M context window. Untested for Magic tool calling — worth trying.

models.name: Grok 4.1 Fast
models._notes: Successor to Grok 4 Fast. 2M context. Improved tool calling.

models.name: Kimi K2.5
models._notes: #1 most popular model on OpenRouter by weekly tokens (1.59T). Trillion-param MoE with 32B active. Untested for Magic tool calling.

models.name: MiniMax M2.1
models._notes: Retired from gauntlet — replaced by M2.5.

models.name: MiniMax M2.5
models._notes: Successor to M2.1. Strong agentic model with RL training. Cheap reasoning.

models.name: GLM 4.7
models._notes: Zhipu AI reasoning model. Popular (181B weekly tokens). Untested for Magic tool calling.

models.name: MiMo V2 Flash
models._notes: Xiaomi reasoning model. Extremely cheap. Untested for Magic tool calling.

models.name: Kimi K2 0905
models._notes: Newer Kimi K2 variant. Trillion-param MoE with 32B active. Untested for Magic tool calling.

models.name: Qwen3 Max Thinking
models._notes: Qwen flagship reasoning model. Untested for Magic tool calling.

models.name: GPT-5 Mini
models._notes: Compact GPT-5 for lighter reasoning tasks. Actually has mandatory reasoning but currently run without reasoning_effort param. Successor to o4-mini. Internal reasoning only — not exposed in response.

models.name: GPT-5 Nano
models._notes: Cheapest OpenAI model. Very popular (300B weekly tokens). Despite the name, generates large hidden reasoning tokens by default — causes 20s+ latency and frequent timeouts without reasoning_effort=low.

models.name: GPT-4.1 Mini
models._notes: Previous-gen OpenAI small model. No reasoning. 1M context. Non-thinking baseline.

models.name: GPT-4o-mini
models._notes: Cheap older OpenAI model. No reasoning. Non-thinking baseline.

models.name: Qwen3 235B
models._notes: Large Qwen3 MoE (235B total, 22B active). Absurdly cheap. No reasoning mode. Non-thinking baseline.

models.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
models._notes: Older Gemini 2.0 Flash. Superseded by 2.5/3 Flash variants. Kept for historical game data.

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick
models._notes: Meta's latest Llama 4. 1M context. No reasoning mode. Non-thinking baseline. Google provider breaks tool calling (outputs ReAct-style text instead of tool_calls).

_recommendations.reasoning: Trimmed gauntlet: dropped Grok 4 (non-Fast), GPT-5 Mini, GPT-5 Nano, Kimi K2 0905, Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro, GPT-4o-mini — all superseded or consistently bottom-tier. MiniMax upgraded from M2.1 to M2.5.
_recommendations.skip_reasoning: o4-mini produces persistent empty responses and stall loops. GPT-5.1 superseded by GPT-5 and GPT-5.2. Mistral Large is non-thinking and underperforms reasoning models.

_thinking_config._comment: How to enable thinking for each provider via OpenRouter's unified reasoning param

anthropic._notes: Thinking content returned in reasoning_content field. Visible and loggable.

google._notes: Maps to Google's thinkingLevel. Thinking content may or may not be in reasoning_content depending on model version.

openai._notes: Internal reasoning only — thinking tokens consumed and billed but NOT returned in response. Cannot log or display thinking trace.

deepseek._notes: Thinking content returned in reasoning_content field.

xai._notes: Grok 4 has mandatory reasoning (always on). Grok 4 Fast supports optional reasoning via enabled param. Reasoning tokens not exposed.

moonshotai._notes: Kimi K2/K2.5 reasoning models. Thinking content exposure unknown — needs testing.

minimax._notes: MiniMax M2.5 reasoning. Thinking content exposure unknown — needs testing.

z-ai._notes: GLM reasoning models. Thinking content exposure unknown — needs testing.

xiaomi._notes: MiMo reasoning models. Thinking content exposure unknown — needs testing.

qwen._notes: Qwen3 Max Thinking. Medium was too slow (45s+ timeouts in 4p games). Thinking content exposure unknown — needs testing.
